summary: Unit tests on every platform of the profile, integration tests against Postgres on Linux, and a quirks suite for paths and line endings on Windows and macOS.

axes.name: os
axes.reason: The profile lists all three platforms; path separators, line endings and file locking differ.

axes.name: postgres
axes.reason: Production runs 16 and the upgrade to 17 is planned; the migrations use features whose behaviour changed.

matrix_changes.name: postgres
matrix_changes.reason: Integration tests need the two supported Postgres versions.

matrix_changes.name: os=windows,postgres=16
matrix_changes.reason: Postgres runs only on Linux; one version is enough on the other platforms.

matrix_changes.name: quirks
matrix_changes.reason: Platform-specific behaviour gets a suite of its own so it can run alone.

assumptions.text: Postgres 16 is the oldest version in production.

open_questions: Must macOS on Apple silicon and on Intel both be covered?
